data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact 0b13382ebfe2 is COMPATIBLE WITH SRC_002's counterexample-first strategy but extends it from the object level to the meta level: SRC_002 rejects 45,46,47 by observing they are not even; 0b13382ebfe2 rejects all non-even-centred triples simultaneously by proving that any valid even triple must be centred on an even mean, eliminating an entire class of rivals in one step rather than one at a time. REFUTED IF 0b13382ebfe2 does not perform class-level elimination, or if it only eliminates a single counterexample as SRC_002 does.
